text_block_list.text: Can you believe in that which you cannot<n>see?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... You're incredibly fast, without a<n>doubt... I'm going to have to
do better<n>than this...
That which is only beheld in the eyes of<n>another?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...So that I can catch up... to my friend...
Who exactly are you?
It's well past dusk when I realize I've<n>forgotten my phone somewhere.

I probably set it down while focusing on<n>watching some training
sessions around the<n>academy today.

I jog back to where I assume I've left the<n>thing, and am reassuringly
greeted by a<n>flashing low-battery light.
Hehe...

—s is fun... hehe...
—ow can I... —atch up?

I don't expect to hear anything on the<n>track at this hour, let alone
laughter. Is<n>someone really out here training right<n>now?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Phew... Don't worry... I can keep going.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...That's right. However many more times it<n>takes...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...I really love... running with you...
choice_data_list: (Just, uh... who is she talking to?)

text_block_list.text:
There's certainly no one around besides us.<n>I know that it's quite dark
out, but still.<n>Thinking it strange, I approach the lone<n>student, when...
Thwack!

It feels as if something has rammed into my<n>shoulder. I can't see
anything in the<n>vicinity, however.

But a girl talking to someone who isn't<n>there? And then myself
colliding with<n>some kind of invisible force?

The night air isn't the only thing giving me<n>the chills... Though it's
probably just my<n>imagination running wild...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Are you for real? I'll gladly take up the<n>offer! It's always been my
dream to make it<n>big in a G1 race!

text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer A
text_block_list.text: For real. Let's turn that dream into reality!

text_block_list.name: Nervous Uma Musume
text_block_list.text:
Y… yes! I want to race in the Twinkle Series! 
More than anything in the world…!!

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
I sense you've got what it takes. I'll be<n>back to watch your tryout race.
Think you<n>can show me everything you've got?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
choice_data_list: Oh, right. The girl from last night...

text_block_list.name: New Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, <username>!<n>Looks like you've got your
eyes on<n>someone.

text_block_list.name: New Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Oh, the girl over there? ...She does run<n>with mighty fine form. Are you
gonna scout<n>her?
choice_data_list: Well, I'm not so sure just yet...

text_block_list.name: New Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Really? I've definitely seen her<n>somewhere, though... Um, maybe in
these<n>pamphlets, yeah?

text_block_list.name: New Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Found her—Manhattan Cafe. She's good. If<n>you're not going to scout
her, then I'm off<n>to chat to her.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: You want... to scout me?

text_block_list.name: New Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! If you don't have anyone else in<n>mind, why don't we aim for the
top of the<n>Twinkle Series together?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: The Twinkle Series...

text_block_list.name: New Trainer A
text_block_list.text: You can outrun anyone else out here for<n>sure!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...Anyone else? Hm... Do you think... Icould even outrun... her?

text_block_list.name: New Trainer A
text_block_list.text: ..."Her"? Who? Oh, I'm guessing you have<n>a rival then?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...Yes. She's incredibly fast... That girl<n>standing right over there...

text_block_list.name: New Trainer A
text_block_list.text: O-over there? But there's no one th—

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: She looks like me... She's the one who led<n>me here. My dear friend...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
She hasn't changed since we were<n>children... Always running ahead of
me... I<n>dream of... reaching her...

text_block_list.name: New Trainer A
text_block_list.text: Huh...

text_block_list.name: New Trainer A
text_block_list.text: Sigh... Save your breath. Don't think she'slooking to really talk to anyone, let alonebe scouted.

text_block_list.name: New Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't make heads or tails of anything<n>she was babbling about... It
was like she<n>was trying to drive me off. And honestly,<n>the things she
was saying were kind of,<n>uh...

text_block_list.name: New Trainer A
text_block_list.text: Kind of creepy?

text_block_list.name: New Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
I'm just saying that maybe you shouldn't<n>bother. She seems to be
more trouble than<n>anything...
I'm reminded of what happened last night.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...That's right. However many more times it<n>takes...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...I really love... running with you...

I chalk up all that happened last night to<n>my imagination, but perhaps
there is<n>something more at play here.
Does she really not have any interest in<n>being scouted?

My mind drifts, pondering the mysterious<n>Manhattan Cafe. Next thing
I know, the<n>sky has darkened into a murky night...
